findings.finding: a gate present in base but dropped from the changed run was reported clean (exit 0), contradicting the script's own docstring about catching a vanished gate; a false-clean vector (delete a green gate, get 0 new failures).
findings.resolution: fixed: the script now collects gates present in base but absent from changed and reports them as DROPPED, blocking clean (exit 1); proven by two new discriminating tests (dropped green gate; dropped red gate). Docstring and reference doc updated to match.

findings.finding: a zero-record run (empty changed, or both empty) reported a positive clean verdict with an output hash instead of failing closed, unlike the repo's sibling zero-scan gates.
findings.resolution: fixed: the script now dies (exit 2) when base or changed has zero gate records, matching the zero-scan-fails-closed idiom; proven by two new tests.
